summary: Iteration 4 (NAVDECK rebrand + new pages + AI). Backend: new pytest suite test_navdeck_iter5.py, 18/18 passing: presence, stats, logbook, documents/PDF, VATSIM pilots/member, METAR, notes, AI SSE chat + history, min_takeoff, lat/lon, close->PDF->soft-delete, cross-user isolation. Regression suites iter3+iter4: 19/19 passing. Frontend (Playwright, 1920 and iPad 1180x820): sign-in branding + tab switching, Clerk ticket sign-in, refresh keeps session, sign-out returns to /sign-in, navbar links/online count/zulu, home stats match /api/stats, theme toggle (dark is default), SimBrief planner link + save + import, Briefing min take-off fuel (68,799) + AI briefing stream, Enroute route map + plane marker moves as MERIT/HFD/TOC are ticked, N806SB shows re-sync hint, Arrival notes save/persist + AI METAR decode, Close signature pad gating, signing, AI debrief, close -> PDF stored (checked the PDF content: min T/O fuel, METAR, runway, notes, commander, landing rate, signature image), logbook totals/row/PDF, VATSIM map (1724 pilots/216 ATC), CID validation/import/member info, prefile href params, co-pilot chat. Found and fixed one crash: CopilotChat threw 'destroy is not a function' on sending a message. Found one 500 on METAR fetch and one data-loading bug on Home/VATSIM.

critical.issue: No error handling around requests.get to aviationweather.gov. A ReadTimeout (seen in the UI run, traceback in backend.err.log) returns 500. The upstream status is also not checked: aviationweather returned 502/504 to curl during testing, and in that case the HTML error body would come back as the 'metar' text and be saved into the flight's arrival notes. Fix: wrap in try/except requests.RequestException -> 502 with a clear detail; treat 204 as metar=None; on any other non-200, return 502 and don't use resp.text.

minor.issue: Same pattern: no try/except on the requests call and no check before resp.json(). A network error or a non-JSON 5xx/429 from api.vatsim.net becomes an unhandled 500. Return 502 instead.
None values are dropped from the update, so a user can never clear vatsim_cid (or simbrief_pilot_id) once set. Accept an empty string or explicit null as 'clear'.
Calls the LLM even when no METAR is stored, which spends credits on 'no METAR provided' replies. Return 400 or disable the decode button when the METAR is empty.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent. useEffect(() => end.current?.scrollIntoView(...)) returned the call's result as the effect cleanup. Current Chrome returns a Promise from scrollIntoView, so React threw 'destroy is not a function' and the whole app crashed into the error overlay as soon as a message was sent. The effect body is now wrapped in braces. Retest: the streamed reply renders, history persists after reload, no page errors.

ui_bugs.component: HomePage 'Flights in progress' + VatsimPage prefile flight select
ui_bugs.issue: Both read open flights only from the localStorage cache, which only the /flights page fills. In a fresh session (new device, cleared storage, or not visiting /flights first) Home shows 'No open flights' and the VATSIM panel shows 'Import a SimBrief OFP first' even though N806SB is open in the DB. Reproduced twice. Fetch GET /api/flights on mount, as FlightsPage does.

integration_issues.issue: GET /api/documents/{id}/file returns 200 application/pdf (34 KB), but the window.open('') + blob URL tab stayed about:blank in headless Chromium. This is probably a headless limitation. Check manually on iPad Safari: blob URLs set on a pre-opened window can be blocked. A fallback is to download via an <a download> link.

issues: Navbar is rendered inside each page, so it remounts on every route change and sends POST /presence each time (8 calls in about 40 s during testing) instead of once a minute. Lift Navbar or the heartbeat into a layout.
RouteMap <Fit points={line}> gets a new array on every render, so fitBounds runs on every waypoint tick and resets any pan/zoom the user made. Memoise line or fit only once.
RouteMap plane heading after the final fix is ticked uses bearing(pos, line[1]), which points back toward the second fix.
VatsimPage saveCid has no try/catch, so a PUT /me failure gives an unhandled promise rejection and no toast.
Co-pilot panel (380x520) covers the right half of the content at iPad 1180 width. Acceptable, but consider a bottom sheet on tablet.

action_items: Harden GET /api/metar/{icao}: catch requests exceptions and non-200 responses -> 502. Never save the upstream error body as the METAR.
HomePage and VatsimPage: load open flights from GET /api/flights instead of relying only on cache.getFlights().
Optional: send the presence heartbeat once per app (not per page mount); memoise the RouteMap fit; add try/catch to saveCid; skip the AI METAR call when no METAR is stored.
critical_code_review_comments: extras.py metar/vatsim_member: external HTTP calls without exception handling or status checks (see backend issues).

CopilotChat: arrow-function useEffect returning a value crashed the app (fixed). AirlineLogo.jsx uses useEffect(() => setIdx(0)), which is harmless because setState returns undefined, but prefer a braced body.
server.py is 734 lines, just over the 700-line guideline. Consider moving the OFP parsing and _backfill into their own module.

store_report errors are only logged. If the PDF upload fails, the flight shows 'signed PDF saved to your Logbook' even though no document exists. Surface a document_saved flag so the UI shows the real state.

success_rate.frontend: ~92%: all requested flows verified; 1 crash fixed; Home/VATSIM open-flight list bug outstanding

rca of the issue: Copilot crash: CopilotChat.jsx line 19 used an expression-bodied useEffect, so the return value of end.current.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'}) became the effect cleanup. Current Chrome returns a Promise from scrollIntoView, so on the next msgs change React called promise() and threw 'destroy is not a function'. Repro: open the co-pilot and send any message. Mitigation: braced effect body (applied). METAR 500: extras.metar calls requests.get with timeout=10 and no try/except. aviationweather.gov timed out (urllib3 ReadTimeoutError in backend.err.log), so FastAPI returned 500. Home/VATSIM empty: both components read cache.getFlights() (localStorage key written only by FlightsPage.load), so they are empty until /flights has been visited in that browser.
